programme.title: Mr. Vampire 2
programme.desc: Grave robbers unearth preserved vampires. Transporting child vampire, its spell breaks, befriending locals. Parent vampires awaken, escape. Herbalist pursues to destroy them.

programme.title: Final Justice
programme.desc: A cop relies on a young car thief to take down four gangsters, who plan to rob a rich merchant for a large amount of money.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: A woman is raped and murdered during World War 2. Forty years later she returns to haunt her persecutors from the Tao Tao Mansion. A professor and his family move into the house, only to have the spirits take their son.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: The whole school is held hostage during the day of an English speech competition. As Ip Man decides to step up and rise to the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: A Hong Kong taxi driver's life horribly falls apart after accidentally hitting a sorcerer with his cab. He decides to seek the sorcerer's help to turn the curse on his enemies at the expense of his own life.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs 3
programme.desc: 10 months after the murder of Yan, Ming is transferred to do the office work. Meanwhile, a new star Wing has emerged in the police force. Ming suspects he is also a mole sent by the triad.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows.

programme.title: Royal Tramp 2
programme.desc: Wei the jester, turned undercover spy, turned high ranking official in the Chinese imperial court, tries his best to deal with warring factions and deadly martial artists all vying for power.

programme.title: The Mask Of Shura Of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: The Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil.

programme.title: The Sorcerer And The White Snake
programme.desc: A master monk tries to protect a naive young physician from a thousand-year-old snake demon. A contest of psychic powers results in mayhem.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Action superstar Chow Yun-Fat portrays real-life gangster Chen Daqi as he rises to the upper echelons of power, finding himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: A failed assassination attempt in Harbin, China in 1909 changes the course of history. Now two JBI agents must find the connections between it and an ancient Korean artifact.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: A regime shift in Leka stirs chaos. Police send undercover Zheng Zha into Song Bang’s gang, unaware others are waiting to strike back and settle old scores.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A Chinese spy who's been out of service for ten years whilst making a living as a butcher is sent to Hong Kong to locate a stolen Tyrannosaurus rex skull.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: For five years, 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his fathers near-obsolete Toyota AE86 every morning and because of that, he has become a good racer and also unwillingly perfected the art of drifting.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey: Pandora's Box
programme.desc: A Monkey King is reincarnated in the un human form as Joker, a highwayman oblivious to his original identity and the fact that 500 years earlier, he and his master, the Longevity Monk, were punished and made to stay human.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Open The Coffin
programme.desc: A supernatural mystery film with a detective investigating murders that seem to be the result of a curse.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: Centering on Ip Man's migration to Hong Kong in 1949 as he attempts to propagate his discipline of Wing Chun martial arts.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy about a murdered cop returning from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie (Chow) into avenging his death.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Never Leave

programme.title: Mr. Vampire

programme.title: Challenge Of The Gamesters

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: An unassuming young lawyer leads a fight against the Nazis near the end of World War II.

programme.title: Another Mother's Son
programme.desc: Lou lives on the Nazi-occupied Island of Jersey during World War 2. She accepts to hide a young Russian POW at her house at the risk of being imprisoned herself and takes care of him as if he was her own son.

programme.title: War Pigs
programme.desc: A ragtag unit of misfits known as the War Pigs must go behind enemy lines to exterminate Nazis by any means necessary.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Tormented by his past, a garbage man named Clean attempts a quiet life of redemption. But, soon finds himself forced to reconcile with the violence of his past.

programme.title: The Last Son
programme.desc: An outlaw attempts to end his evil family line.

programme.title: Any Bullet Will Do
programme.desc: In 1876, a bounty hunter tracks his own brother through Montana with the help of a fur trapper.

programme.title: While We Sleep
programme.desc: After observing a hauntingly familiar abnormal CAT scan of a 13 year old girl, radiologist Nina Evanko battles to find the source of the young girl's sleeping disorder. What she discovers is darker and stranger than she could have imagined.

programme.title: Candy Land
programme.desc: A seemingly naive and devout young woman navigates her way into the underground world of truck stop sex workers a.k.a. lot lizards.

programme.title: Havenhurst
programme.desc: A troubled young woman takes up residence in a gothic apartment building where she must confront a terrifying evil.

programme.title: Old Henry
programme.desc: A farmer takes in an injured man with a satchel of cash. When a posse comes for the money, he must decide who to trust. Defending a siege, he reveals a gunslinging talent calling his true identity into question.

programme.title: Hotel Dunsmuir
programme.desc: A young woman with extrasensory perception flees her abusive husband, only to land at an historic hotel containing a sinister presence.

programme.title: The Price We Pay
programme.desc: After a pawn shop robbery goes askew, two criminals take refuge at a remote farmhouse to try to let the heat die down, but find something much more menacing.

programme.title: Winter War
programme.desc: In 1939, two Finnish brothers are conscripted in the army to fight in the war between Finland and the Soviet Union.

programme.title: The Ballad Of Davy Crockett
programme.desc: In 1815, an American Legend, whose wife has fallen deathly ill, leaving his young children to survive on their own, must fight his way back to them across the many perils found in the Savage Lands of the wild frontier.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: American gangster Erik Vasquez is scheming to become the top dog in the Mexican underworld, only to find himself making enemies out of both the powerful cartels and his own allies.

programme.title: Gravy
programme.desc: It's All Hallow's Eve. A trio of costumed misfits with very special dietary requirements seizes a Mexican cantina and force the staff to engage in a late night of gaming, food and libations. The only caveat is what's on the menu.

programme.title: Come Out Fighting
programme.desc: Set during World War 2, a squad of American Army soldiers are sent on a mission behind lines to locate their missing commanding officer.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: In the lawless West, a notorious brotherhood of killers and thieves called The Cowboys reigns over the land with brutal fists and fast guns. Fate finally catches up with them.

programme.title: No Visitors
programme.desc: Respected surgeon Lewis Cutterman hides a dark secret. His family drugs guests and slowly consumes them, harvesting organs to sell for desperate patients in a twisted family business.

programme.title: The Great War
programme.desc: During the last days of the Great War, a group of U.S. soldiers are sent behind enemy lines to rescue a lost platoon.

programme.title: The Hatching
programme.desc: On the death of his father, Tim Webber returns to his childhood village in Somerset to find something sinister is disturbing the idyllic peace of the villagers.

programme.title: The School
programme.desc: When a doctor looking for her missing child awakens to find herself in an abandoned school, she must survive the supernatural terror and face her own demons if she is to find the truth about where her son is.

programme.title: Another Mother's Son
programme.desc: Lou lives on the Nazi-occupied Island of Jersey during World War 2. She accepts to hide a young Russian POW at her house at the risk of being imprisoned herself and takes care of him as if he was her own son.

programme.title: The Last Champion
programme.desc: When his mother dies, scandal-ridden ex-Olympian John Wright returns to a hometown that has not forgiven him.

programme.title: Riot
programme.desc: Cop Jack Stone robs a Russian mob bank to end in the same prison as the mob boss killing Jack's wife. An inmate helps him as does a reporter. Lots of fights.

programme.title: The Pig Farmer
programme.desc: Award-winning investigation into the crimes of Robert Pickton. This documentary explores why it took so many years to capture and convict Canada's most prolific serial killer. Troubling revelations about who knew what, and when.

programme.title: Temple
programme.desc: Three American tourists follow a mysterious map deep into the jungles of Japan searching for an ancient temple. When spirits entrap them, their adventure quickly becomes a horrific nightmare.

programme.title: Hacker
programme.desc: With the help of his new friends Alex Danyliuk turns to a life of crime and identity theft.

programme.title: The Intruders
programme.desc: After the traumatic loss of her mother, a teenaged girl tries to uncover the dark secrets behind her new home, in spite of her father's disbelief.

programme.title: Sex Tape (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: A married couple wake up to discover that the sex tape they made the evening before has gone missing, leading to a frantic search for its whereabouts.

programme.title: Passengers (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: A malfunction in a sleeping pod on a spacecraft traveling to a distant colony planet wakes one passenger 90 years early.

programme.title: Chappie
programme.desc: Chappie tells the story of a robot imbued with artificial intelligence who is stolen by two local gangsters who want to use him for their own nefarious purposes.

programme.title: The International
programme.desc: Clive Owen stars as an Interpol agent who attempts to expose a high-profile financial institution's role in an international arms dealing ring.

programme.title: Zombieland
programme.desc: A shy student, a gun-toting bruiser and a pair of sisters join forces in a trek across a zombie-filled America.

programme.title: The Grudge
programme.desc: A house is cursed by a vengeful ghost that dooms those who enter it with a violent death.

programme.title: She's Funny That Way
programme.desc: On the set of a playwright's new project, a love triangle forms between his wife, her ex-lover and the call-girl-turned-actress cast in the production.

programme.title: The 5th Wave
programme.desc: Four waves of increasingly deadly alien attacks have left most of Earth decimated. Now Cassie needs to prepare for the 5th wave while trying to save her brother.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: An imprisoned drug kingpin offers a huge cash reward to anyone that can break him out of police custody, and only the L.A.P.D.'s Special Weapons and Tactics team can prevent it.

programme.title: Salt
programme.desc: A CIA agent goes on the run after a defector accuses her of being a Russian spy.

programme.title: Blumhouse's Fantasy Island
programme.desc: When the owner and operator of a luxurious island invites a collection of guests to live out their most elaborate fantasies in relative seclusion, chaos quickly descends.

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: A failed reporter is bonded to an alien entity, one of many symbiotes who have invaded Earth. But the being takes a liking to Earth and decides to protect it.

programme.title: The Dark Tower
programme.desc: A boy haunted by visions of a dark tower from a parallel reality teams up with the tower's guardian to stop an evil that want to destroy the tower and open the gates of Hell.

programme.title: Straw Dogs (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Los Angeles screenwriter David Sumner relocates with his wife to her hometown in the deep South. There, while tensions build between them, a brewing conflict with locals becomes a threat to them both.

programme.title: Zathura: A Space Adventure (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Two young brothers are drawn into an intergalactic adventure when their house is hurled through the depths of space by the magical board game they are playing.

programme.title: The Other Guys (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Two mismatched New York City detectives seize an opportunity to step up like the city's top cops, whom they idolize, only things don't quite go as planned.

programme.title: Minority Report
programme.desc: John works with the PreCrime police which stop crimes before they take place, with the help of three 'PreCogs' who can foresee crimes. Events ensue when John finds himself framed for a future murder.

programme.title: Slender Man
programme.desc: Four high school girls perform a ceremony to summon internet boogeyman Slenderman. Once they see him, they can't get rid of him. And one by one, the girls are driven mad, die, or disappear.

programme.title: The Night Before

programme.title: National Security

Cerita berpusat pada Aki yang menceritakan dongeng kepada dua cucunya, Aris dan Ara, yang tinggal bersamanya di kampung. Animasi ini mengandung nilai moral, nasihat kehidupan, dan hiburan.

programme.title: Amazing Kids : Kiko
programme.desc: Animasi Kiko mengisahkan petualangan Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki yang mandiri dan riang, bersama empat sahabat setianya: Lola (ikan diskus), Ting Ting (kepiting), Patino (ikan patin), dan Poli (ikan cupang). Mereka menjalani berbagai kisah seru dan memecahkan masalah di bawah laut.

programme.title: Amazing Kids : Entong
programme.desc: Animasi Entong adalah anak laki-laki Betawi berusia 10 tahun yang cerdas, saleh, dan ceria. Ia tinggal bersama ibunya, Fatimeh, di sebuah perkampungan setelah ayahnya meninggal. Kisah ini mengikuti petualangan harian Entong, persahabatannya, serta persaingannya dengan anak-anak lain seperti Memet.

programme.desc: Robocar Poli Bercerita Mengenai Petualangan Tim Penyelamatan Brooms Town Dalam Menjaga Keamanan Kotanya. Bread Dan Keluarganya Siap Membantu Para Selebriti Untuk Menemukan Lagi Kebahagiaan Mereka.

programme.title: Traffic Safety With Poli
programme.desc: Cerita Berpusat Pada Kevin Dan Doug, Dua Anak Kecil Di Kota Broomstown Yang Sering Bermain Ceroboh Dan Melanggar Aturan Lalu Lintas, Seperti Menyeberang Sembarangan Atau Mengejar Bola Ke Jalan Raya. Ketika Aksi Usil Mereka Berujung Bahaya, Tim Penyelamat Robocar Yang Dipimpin Oleh Poli (Mobil Polisi Robot) Selalu Datang Tepat Waktu Untuk Menyelamatkan Mereka.

programme.title: Boboiboy
programme.desc: Sebuah Program Animasi Yang Mengisahkan Boboiboy Dan Teman-Temannya Yakni Gopal, Ying, Dan Yaya Yang Masing-Masing Memiliki Kekuatan Super. Dengan Kekuatan Yang Dimiliki Mereka Mencegah Adu Du Mencuri Biji Kakao Tok Aba Yang Digunakan Sebagai Sumber Energi. Selain Itu, Boboiboy Dan Teman-Temannya Menjadi Pahlawan Super Dalam Menumpas Kejahatan Dan Menjaga Kedamaian Bumi.

programme.title: Blox Buster

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.desc: Rainbow Ruby Adalah Kisah Tentang Seorang Gadis Kecil Yang Gagah Dan Banyak Akal Yang Secara Ajaib Diangkut Ke Rainbow 'Village, Tanah Aneh Yang Dihuni Oleh Mainannya, Dan Berubah Menjadi Pekerjaan Yang Berbeda Untuk Membantu Mencegah Bencana . Serial Ini Mengambil Fantasi Masa Kecil Boneka Menjadi Hidup, Dan Bercampur Dalam Pahlawan Wanita Aspiratif Yang Membuktikan Bahwa Anda Bisa Menjadi Apa Pun Yang Anda Inginkan .

programme.title: Adit Sopo Jarwo
programme.desc: Animasi Indonesia, Berisikan Kisah Kehidupan Sehari-Hari Masyarakat Indonesia Yang Dipenuhi Dengan Pengetahuan, Kelucuan, Kisah Persahabatan, Serta Nilai Persatuan, Kesatuan, Dan Kebudayaan. Tokoh Dalam Cerita Ini Diantaranya Adit (Tokoh Utama, Seorang Anak Laki-Laki), Adelya (Adik Adit), Teman-Teman Adit Yakni Dennis, Mitha, Dan Devi. programme.title: Ejen Ali

Tanpa Bantuan I.R.I.S., Ali Harus Berjuang Mengandalkan Kemampuan Dan Latihan Aslinya Untuk Membuktikan Diri.
